53: /**
54:  * Base query class for all spatial geometries: {@link LatLonShape}, {@link LatLonPoint} and {@link
55:  * XYShape}. In order to create a query, use the factory methods on those classes.
56:  *
57:  * @lucene.internal
58:  */
59: abstract class SpatialQuery extends Query {
60:   /** field name */
61:   final String field;
62:   /**
63:    * query relation disjoint: {@link QueryRelation#DISJOINT}, intersects: {@link
64:    * QueryRelation#INTERSECTS}, within: {@link QueryRelation#DISJOINT}, contains: {@link
65:    * QueryRelation#CONTAINS}
66:    */
67:   final QueryRelation queryRelation;
68: 
69:   final Geometry[] geometries;
70:   final Component2D queryComponent2D;
71: 
72:   protected SpatialQuery(String field, final QueryRelation queryRelation, Geometry... geometries) {
73:     if (field == null) {
74:       throw new IllegalArgumentException("field must not be null");
75:     }
76:     if (queryRelation == null) {
77:       throw new IllegalArgumentException("queryRelation must not be null");
78:     }
79:     this.field = field;
80:     this.queryRelation = queryRelation;
81:     this.geometries = geometries.clone();
82:     this.queryComponent2D = createComponent2D(geometries);
83:   }
84: 
85:   protected abstract Component2D createComponent2D(Geometry... geometries);

87:   /**
88:    * returns the spatial visitor to be used for this query. Called before generating the query
89:    * {@link Weight}
90:    */
91:   protected abstract SpatialVisitor getSpatialVisitor();

93:   /** Visitor used for walking the BKD tree. */
94:   protected abstract static class SpatialVisitor {
95:     /** relates a range of points (internal node) to the query */
96:     protected abstract Relation relate(byte[] minPackedValue, byte[] maxPackedValue);
97: 
98:     /** Gets a intersects predicate. Called when constructing a {@link Scorer} */
99:     protected abstract Predicate<byte[]> intersects();
100: 
101:     /** Gets a within predicate. Called when constructing a {@link Scorer} */
102:     protected abstract Predicate<byte[]> within();
103: 
104:     /** Gets a contains function. Called when constructing a {@link Scorer} */
105:     protected abstract Function<byte[], Component2D.WithinRelation> contains();
106: 
107:     private Predicate<byte[]> containsPredicate() {
108:       final Function<byte[], Component2D.WithinRelation> contains = contains();
109:       return bytes -> contains.apply(bytes) == Component2D.WithinRelation.CANDIDATE;
110:     }
111: 
112:     private BiFunction<byte[], byte[], Relation> getInnerFunction(
113:         ShapeField.QueryRelation queryRelation) {
114:       if (queryRelation == QueryRelation.DISJOINT) {
115:         return (minPackedValue, maxPackedValue) ->
116:             transposeRelation(relate(minPackedValue, maxPackedValue));
117:       }
118:       return (minPackedValue, maxPackedValue) -> relate(minPackedValue, maxPackedValue);
119:     }
120: 
121:     private Predicate<byte[]> getLeafPredicate(ShapeField.QueryRelation queryRelation) {
122:       switch (queryRelation) {
123:         case INTERSECTS:
124:           return intersects();
125:         case WITHIN:
126:           return within();
127:         case DISJOINT:
128:           return intersects().negate();
129:         case CONTAINS:
130:           return containsPredicate();
131:         default:
132:           throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported query type :[" + queryRelation + "]");
133:       }
134:     }
135:   }

137:   @Override
138:   public void visit(QueryVisitor visitor) {
139:     if (visitor.acceptField(field)) {
140:       visitor.visitLeaf(this);
141:     }
142:   }

148:   protected ScorerSupplier getScorerSupplier(
149:       LeafReader reader,
150:       SpatialVisitor spatialVisitor,
151:       ScoreMode scoreMode,
152:       ConstantScoreWeight weight,
153:       float boost,
154:       float score)
155:       throws IOException {
156:     final PointValues values = reader.getPointValues(field);
157:     if (values == null) {
158:       // No docs in this segment had any points fields
159:       return null;
160:     }
161:     final FieldInfo fieldInfo = reader.getFieldInfos().fieldInfo(field);
162:     if (fieldInfo == null) {
163:       // No docs in this segment indexed this field at all
164:       return null;
165:     }
166: 
167:     final Relation rel =
168:         spatialVisitor
169:             .getInnerFunction(queryRelation)
170:             .apply(values.getMinPackedValue(), values.getMaxPackedValue());
171:     if (rel == Relation.CELL_OUTSIDE_QUERY
172:         || (rel == Relation.CELL_INSIDE_QUERY && queryRelation == QueryRelation.CONTAINS)) {
173:       // no documents match the query
174:       return null;
175:     } else if (values.getDocCount() == reader.maxDoc() && rel == Relation.CELL_INSIDE_QUERY) {
176:       // all documents match the query
177:       return new ScorerSupplier() {
178:         @Override
179:         public Scorer get(long leadCost) {
180:           return new ConstantScoreScorer(
181:               weight, score, scoreMode, DocIdSetIterator.all(reader.maxDoc()));
182:         }
183: 
184:         @Override
185:         public long cost() {
186:           return reader.maxDoc();
187:         }
188:       };
189:     } else {
190:       if (queryRelation != QueryRelation.INTERSECTS
191:           && queryRelation != QueryRelation.CONTAINS
192:           && values.getDocCount() != values.size()
193:           && hasAnyHits(spatialVisitor, queryRelation, values) == false) {
194:         // First we check if we have any hits so we are fast in the adversarial case where
195:         // the shape does not match any documents and we are in the dense case
196:         return null;
197:       }
198:       // walk the tree to get matching documents
199:       return new RelationScorerSupplier(values, spatialVisitor, queryRelation, field) {
200:         @Override
201:         public Scorer get(long leadCost) throws IOException {
202:           return getScorer(reader, weight, score, scoreMode);
203:         }
204:       };
205:     }
206:   }

279:   /**
280:    * utility class for implementing constant score logic specific to INTERSECT, WITHIN, and DISJOINT
281:    */
282:   private abstract static class RelationScorerSupplier extends ScorerSupplier {
283:     private final PointValues values;
284:     private final SpatialVisitor spatialVisitor;
285:     private final QueryRelation queryRelation;
286:     private final String field;
287:     private long cost = -1;
288: 
289:     RelationScorerSupplier(
290:         final PointValues values,
291:         SpatialVisitor spatialVisitor,
292:         final QueryRelation queryRelation,
293:         final String field) {
294:       this.values = values;
295:       this.spatialVisitor = spatialVisitor;
296:       this.queryRelation = queryRelation;
297:       this.field = field;
298:     }
299: 
300:     protected Scorer getScorer(
301:         final LeafReader reader, final Weight weight, final float boost, final ScoreMode scoreMode)
302:         throws IOException {
303:       switch (queryRelation) {
304:         case INTERSECTS:
305:           return getSparseScorer(reader, weight, boost, scoreMode);
306:         case CONTAINS:
307:           return getContainsDenseScorer(reader, weight, boost, scoreMode);
308:         case WITHIN:
309:         case DISJOINT:
310:           return values.getDocCount() == values.size()
311:               ? getSparseScorer(reader, weight, boost, scoreMode)
312:               : getDenseScorer(reader, weight, boost, scoreMode);
313:         default:
314:           throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported query type :[" + queryRelation + "]");
315:       }
316:     }
317: 
318:     /** Scorer used for INTERSECTS and single value points */
319:     private Scorer getSparseScorer(
320:         final LeafReader reader, final Weight weight, final float boost, final ScoreMode scoreMode)
321:         throws IOException {
322:       if (queryRelation == QueryRelation.DISJOINT
323:           && values.getDocCount() == reader.maxDoc()
324:           && values.getDocCount() == values.size()
325:           && cost() > reader.maxDoc() / 2) {
326:         // If all docs have exactly one value and the cost is greater
327:         // than half the leaf size then maybe we can make things faster
328:         // by computing the set of documents that do NOT match the query
329:         final FixedBitSet result = new FixedBitSet(reader.maxDoc());
330:         result.set(0, reader.maxDoc());
331:         final long[] cost = new long[] {reader.maxDoc()};
332:         values.intersect(getInverseDenseVisitor(spatialVisitor, queryRelation, result, cost));
333:         final DocIdSetIterator iterator = new BitSetIterator(result, cost[0]);
334:         return new ConstantScoreScorer(weight, boost, scoreMode, iterator);
335:       } else if (values.getDocCount() < (values.size() >>> 2)) {
336:         // we use a dense structure so we can skip already visited documents
337:         final FixedBitSet result = new FixedBitSet(reader.maxDoc());
338:         final long[] cost = new long[] {0};
339:         values.intersect(getIntersectsDenseVisitor(spatialVisitor, queryRelation, result, cost));
340:         assert cost[0] > 0 || result.cardinality() == 0;
341:         final DocIdSetIterator iterator =
342:             cost[0] == 0 ? DocIdSetIterator.empty() : new BitSetIterator(result, cost[0]);
343:         return new ConstantScoreScorer(weight, boost, scoreMode, iterator);
344:       } else {
345:         final DocIdSetBuilder docIdSetBuilder = new DocIdSetBuilder(reader.maxDoc(), values, field);
346:         values.intersect(getSparseVisitor(spatialVisitor, queryRelation, docIdSetBuilder));
347:         final DocIdSetIterator iterator = docIdSetBuilder.build().iterator();
348:         return new ConstantScoreScorer(weight, boost, scoreMode, iterator);
349:       }
350:     }
351: 
352:     /** Scorer used for WITHIN and DISJOINT */
353:     private Scorer getDenseScorer(
354:         LeafReader reader, Weight weight, final float boost, ScoreMode scoreMode)
355:         throws IOException {
356:       final FixedBitSet result = new FixedBitSet(reader.maxDoc());
357:       final long[] cost;
358:       if (values.getDocCount() == reader.maxDoc()) {
359:         cost = new long[] {values.size()};
360:         // In this case we can spare one visit to the tree, all documents
361:         // are potential matches
362:         result.set(0, reader.maxDoc());
363:         // Remove false positives
364:         values.intersect(getInverseDenseVisitor(spatialVisitor, queryRelation, result, cost));
365:       } else {
366:         cost = new long[] {0};
367:         // Get potential  documents.
368:         final FixedBitSet excluded = new FixedBitSet(reader.maxDoc());
369:         values.intersect(getDenseVisitor(spatialVisitor, queryRelation, result, excluded, cost));
370:         result.andNot(excluded);
371:         // Remove false positives, we only care about the inner nodes as intersecting
372:         // leaf nodes have been already taken into account. Unfortunately this
373:         // process still reads the leaf nodes.
374:         values.intersect(getShallowInverseDenseVisitor(spatialVisitor, queryRelation, result));
375:       }
376:       assert cost[0] > 0 || result.cardinality() == 0;
377:       final DocIdSetIterator iterator =
378:           cost[0] == 0 ? DocIdSetIterator.empty() : new BitSetIterator(result, cost[0]);
379:       return new ConstantScoreScorer(weight, boost, scoreMode, iterator);
380:     }
381: 
382:     private Scorer getContainsDenseScorer(
383:         LeafReader reader, Weight weight, final float boost, ScoreMode scoreMode)
384:         throws IOException {
385:       final FixedBitSet result = new FixedBitSet(reader.maxDoc());
386:       final long[] cost = new long[] {0};
387:       // Get potential  documents.
388:       final FixedBitSet excluded = new FixedBitSet(reader.maxDoc());
389:       values.intersect(
390:           getContainsDenseVisitor(spatialVisitor, queryRelation, result, excluded, cost));
391:       result.andNot(excluded);
392:       assert cost[0] > 0 || result.cardinality() == 0;
393:       final DocIdSetIterator iterator =
394:           cost[0] == 0 ? DocIdSetIterator.empty() : new BitSetIterator(result, cost[0]);
395:       return new ConstantScoreScorer(weight, boost, scoreMode, iterator);
396:     }

398:     @Override
399:     public long cost() {
400:       if (cost == -1) {
401:         // Computing the cost may be expensive, so only do it if necessary
402:         cost = values.estimateDocCount(getEstimateVisitor(spatialVisitor, queryRelation));
403:         assert cost >= 0;
404:       }
405:       return cost;
406:     }
407:   }

## Summary

**Root cause** (`lucene/core/src/java/org/apache/lucene/document/ShapeField.java`, `resolveTriangleType`): when an indexed polygon is so flat that quantization collapses one of its tessellation triangles, `resolveTriangleType` simplifies it to a `LINE`. The query side evaluates that line segment with the triangle's `ab` edge flag, but in the collapsed representation the segment actually spans *other* edges of the original triangle (e.g. for `acSame`, the retained segment is also spanned by edge `bc`). When the collapsed edge carried `false` (internal) while the other edge spanning the same segment was `true` (external), the polygon's outer line ended up marked as internal. During a `CONTAINS` search, the query then deduces the polygon is "not closed" and wrongly reports containment.

**Fix**: in all three degenerate-collapse cases (`abSame`, `acSame`, `bcSame`), the retained line segment now takes its "is part of the external polygon" knowledge from the non-collapsed edges spanning it (OR of the two real edge flags), rather than from the edge being collapsed away.
